novel_features.name: Unified local school search
novel_features.description: Search previously synchronized school data across Layers services from one local, pipeable index.
novel_features.rationale: Requires normalizing multiple portal APIs into the CLI's private SQLite store rather than wrapping one endpoint.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this when an agent needs a fast cross-service lookup without repeatedly downloading verbose portal responses.

narrative.headline: School announcements, agenda events, account context, and a private local search surface in one agent-ready CLI.
narrative.value_prop: The CLI unifies the Layers portal and its embedded announcements and agenda services behind stable JSON commands. App-scoped sessions are derived only in process memory, while sync and search support repeated agent workflows without persisting credentials.
narrative.auth_narrative: Set LAYERS_TOKEN and LAYERS_COMMUNITY_ID in the process environment. The CLI derives embedded-app sessions in memory and never prints or persists them.

quickstart.comment: Verify local setup without making a network request.
Read the first page of announcements through an in-memory app session.
Synchronize agenda events for a localized month slug.

troubleshoots.symptom: The context command says community-id is required.
troubleshoots.fix: Set LAYERS_COMMUNITY_ID to the active school community slug and retry.
Refresh LAYERS_TOKEN from a current signed-in browser session; the CLI will derive a fresh app session in memory.

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI for non-interactive Layers Digital reads, JSON pipelines, MCP access, and private local search. Prefer the school portal when a workflow requires visual review or an unsupported write operation.
anti_triggers: Do not use this CLI to send announcements or alter agenda events.
Do not use this CLI for school systems outside Layers Digital.
Do not use cached local data when the latest portal state is mandatory.
